program.section_heading: Certificate of Completion in Residential Construction and Maintenance (Noncredit) with emphasis on employment preparation
outcomes: Demonstrate safe job site practices. (ILOs: Critical thinking, Communication.)
Build and finish to specs a simple wooden structure using standard industry materials and techniques. (ILOs: Information Competency.)
Install and repair plumbing systems commonly encountered in residential and commercial buildings. (ILOs: Critical Thinking, Information Competency.)
Interpret construction and site layout requirements from technical drawings. (ILOs: Communication.)
Explain the permitting and inspection process for a local jurisdiction. (ILOs: Information Competency, Critical Thinking.)

notes: Read only the noncredit Certificate of Completion section; the credit Certificate of Achievement (CNST 010/020/050/060/080, BUMA 001/012, 17 units) printed above it on the same page was ignored.

The catalog prints no hours for this noncredit program; it prints 0 units beside each course and 'MINIMUM CERTIFICATE UNITS 0', so measure is recorded as units with the printed 0 values. Reviewer may wish to confirm course hours from another source.
Outcomes are copied including the ILO parentheticals as printed.

Career entry 'residential maintenance and construction' is taken from 'entry-level work in residential maintenance and construction'; the employers named (contractors, utility providers, facility maintenance organizations, property management companies) are employer types rather than occupations and were not listed.
